summary: The Summer Space Remembers is a story-driven website for ages 8-14 about NASA hardware left on the Moon, on Mars and in deep space. A boy named Lucas travels with the AI companion built into his spacesuit and meets Apollo 11's Eagle, the lunar rovers, the Viking landers, Spirit and Opportunity, and Voyager 1. Each stop is told as a short dialogue, with "How it worked" and "What it discovered" sections that connect the engineering to real science, plus an optional "Want to know more?" answer for curious readers. QR codes open an interactive 3D model of each spacecraft
details: What it does and how it works The Summer Space Remembers is a static website that tells the story of NASA hardware left behind on the Moon, on Mars and in deep space. A boy named Lucas travels with an AI companion built into his spacesuit. At each stop (Apollo 11 "Eagle", the Lunar Roving Vehicles, Viking 1 and 2, Spirit and Opportunity, Voyager 1) they talk with the machine's story in a short dialogue. Each chapter also includes a "How it worked" note, a "What it discovered" list, a status label (left on the surface, mission completed, still operating) and a source link to NASA. An optional "Want to know more?" button reveals a second Q&A for curious readers. A QR code in every chapter opens an interactive 3D model of the spacecraft, with augmented reality on supported phones.
